ambient_events: The flak gun's cradle creaks as it swings a few degrees and stops.
A drift of spent shell cups glints where the grass has been scorched back.
Something in the mechanism pings as it cools.
description: A Slagworks flak pit sunk into the old grassland — a ring of rusted plate and rammed earth open to the sky, the flak gun squatting exposed at its heart on a hand-cranked cradle. It's ugly, old, and built to eat a hit and keep firing; the crew work it in the open with ear-defenders and no illusions. A buckled steel hatch in the pit floor lets down into the bunker where the shell hoist and the gun's guts are kept.
name: Slagworks Flak Pit
